question105.comment:
12 mecanics are working here, managed by Fred. They are submerged by change of lock and iot in the frame (from 90 DP par day leaving the WH to 30 now). They are dividing tasks (there is a wheel repair stand outside, that can also operates as saddle repair stand).
Good practices for : 
- Supsicious battery management (first suspicious battery are isolated, alone, from the rest. Then, after a few days with no changes, they rejoins other isolated battery to prevent global fire).
- They have vices to easily work on the rear wheels
- Distributed pressurized air system at each workstation which allows for a single compressor to be located outside (good safety)

On the waste management : 
- They have enought inner tube to create a palette for evacuation
- They need new barrels for battery evacuation (on site : one used to store battery that took fire and two were taken on Thursday to be delivered to VoltR)

Container has been lock and are now used separately by logisticians.
